basics.summary: Ph.D. student at TUM focusing on self-supervised learning, generative models, and dynamical modeling in single-cell genomics.

work.name: Technical University of Munich (TUM), Helmholtz Munich
work.summary: Collaboration: Contribute to the Causal Cell Dynamics international lab (Helmholtz Munich, MILA Montreal). Develop methods for causally structured deep representation learning to improve our understanding of cellular decisions.
highlights: Co-Organizer Learning Meaningful Representations of Life (LMRL) Workshop at ICLR 2025 (Singapore)
Co-Organizer Explainable ML Workshop at ECCB 2024 (Finland)
Attended Oxford ML Summer School 2022 (UK), Advanced Course on Data Science and ML 2022 (Italy)
Teaching MSc-level: Statistical Learning (SS24), Deep Learning Seminar (WS21-WS24, Organizer since WS24)
Supervision of interns, working- and thesis students
